title: Database Foundation
description: Establish the global Kysely database connection, define all table types, and create the complete initial PostgreSQL schema with migrations.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines interfaces for organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments, attachments, notifications, and audit_logs tables
All tables except organizations include tenant_id: string in types.ts
Generated<> is used ONLY for id, created_at, updated_at, is_active, and read columns
organizations table does NOT include tenant_id column
001_initial.ts creates organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments, attachments, notifications, and audit_logs tables in a single migration file
users.role has CHECK constraint for ('Admin','ProjectManager','Member')
projects.status has CHECK constraint for ('Active','Archived') with default 'Active'
tasks.status has CHECK constraint for ('ToDo','InProgress','Completed') with default 'ToDo'
All foreign keys use ON DELETE CASCADE
Indexes exist on every tenant_id column and on tasks.project_id and tasks.assignee_id
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations on application bootstrap
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Auth Module
description: Implement JWT authentication, registration, login, refresh tokens, global guard, and role decorators.
acceptance_criteria: AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/register marked with @Public()
RegisterDto has email: @IsEmail() @MaxLength(255), password: @IsString() @MinLength(8) @MaxLength(100), first_name: @IsString() @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(100), last_name: same validation
POST /api/auth/register ignores any role in body and creates user with role 'Admin'
POST /api/auth/register creates a new organization and user in a single transaction
POST /api/auth/register returns { id, email, first_name, last_name, role: 'Admin', tenant_id }
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/login marked with @Public()
POST /api/auth/login returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds
JWT payload contains sub, email, role, tenant_id
Global JWT guard is registered using APP_GUARD
@Roles() decorator sets metadata and RolesGuard enforces exact role match
AuthController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports AuthModule

title: Organizations Module
description: Allow creation of a new organization with its first Admin user and return an access token.
acceptance_criteria: OrganizationsController exposes POST /api/organizations marked with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto has name: @IsString() @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(255), email: @IsEmail(), password: @MinLength(8), first_name and last_name required
POST /api/organizations creates organization and Admin user in single transaction
POST /api/organizations returns { access_token, user: { id, email, role: 'Admin', tenant_id } }
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
OrganizationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports OrganizationsModule

title: Users Module
description: Implement tenant-isolated user management including listing users and updating roles.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users with pagination query ?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users filters by tenant_id = req.user.tenant_id
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
UsersController exposes PATCH /api/users/:id/role
PATCH /api/users/:id/role requires @Roles('Admin')
UpdateRoleDto has role: @IsIn(['Admin','ProjectManager','Member'])
Cannot change own role — throws ForbiddenException
Cannot demote last Admin in tenant — throws BadRequestException
Every update query includes .where('tenant_id','=',tenantId)
UsersController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports UsersModule

title: Projects Module
description: Implement project creation, listing, and updating with strict tenant and role enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsController exposes POST /api/projects requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto has name: @IsString() @MaxLength(255), description: @IsOptional() @MaxLength(1000)
POST /api/projects sets status to 'Active' by default
POST /api/projects inserts tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects with pagination
Members only see projects where they are assigned to at least one task
All queries filter by tenant_id
ProjectsController exposes PATCH /api/projects/:id requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
UpdateProjectDto allows optional name, description, status: @IsIn(['Active','Archived'])
ProjectsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports ProjectsModule

title: Tasks Module
description: Implement full task management with tenant isolation and ownership enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: TasksController exposes POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateTaskDto has title: @IsString() @MaxLength(255), description: @IsOptional() @MaxLength(1000), assignee_id: @IsUUID(), status: @IsOptional() @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed'])
POST validates project and assignee belong to same tenant
Default task status is 'ToDo'
TasksController exposes GET /api/tasks with pagination
Member sees only tasks where assignee_id = req.user.id
All queries include .where('tenant_id','=',tenantId)
TasksController exposes PATCH /api/tasks/:id
Admin and ProjectManager can update any task in tenant
Member can update only if task.assignee_id === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
TasksController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports TasksModule

title: Comments and Attachments Module
description: Enable task-level comments and file attachment metadata with strict ownership and tenant enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: CollaborationController exposes POST /api/tasks/:taskId/comments
CreateCommentDto has content: @IsString() @MinLength(1)
POST comment inserts tenant_id and user_id from req.user
DELETE /api/comments/:id allowed only if comment.user_id === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
CollaborationController exposes POST /api/tasks/:taskId/attachments
CreateAttachmentDto has file_name: @IsString(), file_url: @IsString()
All queries filter by tenant_id
List comments endpoint GET /api/tasks/:taskId/comments supports pagination and returns standard meta structure
CollaborationController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports CollaborationModule

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provide dashboard summary statistics and in-app notification listing with read tracking.
acceptance_criteria: InsightsController exposes GET /api/dashboard returning { total_projects, total_tasks, completed_tasks }
Dashboard metrics are filtered by tenant_id
Member dashboard counts only their assigned tasks
InsightsController exposes GET /api/notifications with pagination
GET /api/notifications returns { data: Notification[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read sets read = true only if notification.user_id = req.user.id
All queries filter by tenant_id
InsightsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports InsightsModule

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Implement immutable audit logging for all create, update, and delete actions across the system.
acceptance_criteria: AuditService creates audit_logs record for every create, update, and delete operation with fields: id, tenant_id, user_id, action, entity, entity_id, created_at
AuditController exposes GET /api/audit-logs with pagination requiring @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs filters strictly by tenant_id
GET /api/audit-logs returns { data: AuditLog[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
Audit logs are immutable and no update or delete endpoint exists
AuditController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports AuditModule
